The shared script is byte-identical to HEAD. Initial anchor/ancestor-details reveal and footer media state wait for completed parsing; hashchange and media-query listeners remain intact. The broader suite already contains initial regional-fragment and dedicated no-JavaScript journeys, for the parent final CI gate.

No unconditional nav-ready marker was added to HTML. A disabled or failed navigation script retains existing native links/disclosures and hides the nonfunctional menu toggle through unchanged CSS. New failed-resource tests passed in all three Chromium projects.

Built home, pricing and South Carolina hub each contain exactly one navigation execution after </header> and before <main>, with an identical versioned preload URL. The Manrope font preload uses as=font, font/woff2 and crossorigin, matching the existing self-hosted CSS font used by .studio-site.

Reviewed the inverse-only proof implementation and its PASS record: all 1,214 changed HTML files reproduce the accepted normalized hashes after reversing only these loading-order edits; 11 auxiliary HTML files and all assets/downloads are unchanged. Current src/pages.mjs SHA-256 matches the proof input.

The new observer measures the diagnosed main movement rather than inspecting implementation strings. Its delayed-resource and failed-resource cases both passed in desktop, phone and reduced-motion projects. The complete scoped run records 20 passed and 16 existing project-specific skips; skip conditions match the seven desktop-only resize cases and one text-resize case in each phone project.
